defects_found_and_fixed: Pairing-code rotation could never reach a running Core: Compose bind-mounts each secret as a single file, so the container follows the inode, and rotation used temp-file plus os.replace. Fixed with an in-place write under flock; verified live.
start_readers.sh and prepare_systemd_host.sh interpolated bare variables immediately before full-width punctuation, which aborts under a C/POSIX locale. All four braced, with a repo-wide regression.
doctor.sh --self-test died on an opaque UnicodeDecodeError caused by nine macOS AppleDouble sidecars in the deploy tree. Removed; the self-test now names them.

SOCIAL_ARCHIVE_GITHUB_ARCHIVE_REPOSITORY pointed at Private-Database, collapsing the object-bytes plane into the structured-facts plane. Repointed; the dedicated vault did not exist and was recreated.
backup.py chained the two cold-backup stores, so an R2 failure took the offsite copy from two copies to zero. The frozen pack already iterated them independently; restored.
ExportRequest and PairingRequest accepted unknown fields, so a wrong field name returned 202 having exported nothing. Both now reject extras.
Five test files still asserted the v0.0.0.5 shell and one asserted the completion contract in the extension instead of the server. Reconciled against the frozen pack and the Owner-approved prototype.

known_degradations.root_cause: Extension not installed in the Owner's logged-in Chrome
known_degradations.why_owner_only: No browser is connected to the agent session, so the profile is unreachable.

known_degradations.root_cause: No fine-grained token scoped to LinzeColin/Social-Archive-Vault
known_degradations.why_owner_only: Fine-grained tokens select repositories by ID, so recreating the name cannot re-attach the orphaned token, and no GitHub API can widen one. Using the broad local OAuth credential on the host, or retargeting the third copy at Private-Database, were both rejected as boundary violations.

known_degradations.root_cause: No Notion Integration token or shared data_source_id
known_degradations.why_owner_only: Notion Integration tokens can only be created in Notion's own UI.
known_degradations.partial_mitigation: export_all.py emits notion-import.csv as a zero-credential manual route

known_degradations.why_owner_only: Karakeep and Linkwarden need several GB; the 38 GB root is at 90 percent serving about eight unrelated projects. Pruning another project's images or volumes is not a build-agent decision.
